one_month_reasoning: ALAB's own Q3 2026 report is most likely just outside the window (Q2 was reported Aug 4; Q3 2025 was reported in early November), so no company print is expected before 2026-10-29. Events in the window: hyperscaler Q3 earnings/capex commentary in the last week of October (MSFT/GOOGL/META/AMZN), which has been the main swing factor for AI-connectivity names; the OCP Global Summit in October (product/design-win newsflow, mildly positive); and the Oct 28 FOMC, where Kalshi/Polymarket price a ~69-70% chance of a 25bp hike (largely priced, but a hawkish surprise hurts long-duration high-multiple names). The stock has been whipsawed by sentiment (-10% on Sep 14 on AI-slowdown remarks; SOX fell as much as 29% from its late-June peak). Without an ALAB print I stay near symmetric around $358 with a ~25% one-month sigma (slightly below the 99%/3.5 rule since realized vol includes earnings days), median ~$359 and a hair of positive drift from the Q3 guide (40% q/q growth) that pre-announcement positioning may reward.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (60%): Sep-2027 NTM EPS ~$8.0 x 45x = $360, and EV/sales (40%): NTM revenue ~$3.6B x 17x + ~$2.5B net cash over ~190M diluted shares = $335; blended ~$352, roughly today's price.

reasoning: Base rates first. ALAB is a ~$65B, 99%-realized-vol AI connectivity stock that has already done -68% (Jan to Apr 2025), a run to ~$499, and a ~40% drawdown (Jun to Jul 2026) with fundamentals intact. Its closest peer, Credo, fell ~52% from its high in 2026, and the SOX fell up to 29% from its June peak. So a 12-month distribution with sigma ~70-75% in log terms (below the 99% realized, since realized is inflated by the 2025-26 swings and a larger, more profitable company tends to calm down) is appropriate, and the tails are genuinely fat on both sides. Fundamentals: Q2 revenue $392M (+104% y/y) and a Q3 guide of $540-560M / EPS $1.16-1.21 put the run-rate above the 2027 consensus trajectory ($2.97B / $6.39), so near-term estimates have upside. But the stock already trades ~56x 2027 EPS, and hyperscaler capex growth is forecast to decelerate sharply in 2027. The usual pattern for hyper-growth semis in that phase is multiple compression that roughly offsets EPS growth. My fair value is ~$352 (P/E 45x on ~$8 NTM EPS and EV/sales 17x), roughly the current price, and the analyst mean ($390, range $190-500) is similar. Macro odds from prediction markets are a mild headwind: a Fed hike ~70% for October, 35% recession by end-2027, and ~18% odds of an AI-industry downturn by end-2026. I put the median ~$360-365 (EPS growth offset by de-rating), a lognormal with sigma ~0.72, a slightly thinner extreme upper tail, and a 25/50/25 bear/base/bull mix of $170/$370/$650 (probability-weighted mean ~$390). Research was limited to ~10 queries; the Q3 report date was not yet announced, and I inferred early November from last year's timing.
